headline: Adopted practice of publishing only the redacted application in agendas; other materials available on request.
summary: The meeting discussed a Maintenance of Net Operating Income application but made no decisions on it. Members voted to publish only the application with contact information redacted, and to make other materials available on request.
decisions: Adopted practice of publishing only the application with contact information redacted in the agenda, with other materials available on request. Passed 5-0, with Razat absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Matthew Lax moves that the Board adopts the practice of publishing only the application with contact information redacted from it in the agenda and providing notice, information, and direction that the rest of the materials are available upon request. Seconded by Jonas Burke. (5-0; Razat absent) The motion passes.
